slides.narration: Chapter 13: The Speed of Light. In this framework, the speed of light is not a postulate — it is a theorem. It is the only speed consistent with the lattice structure of the tower.

The speed of light is finite because the lattice has a spacing. It is unique because no other speed is self-consistent on the lattice. And it is invariant because all examiners — all towers — are structurally equivalent. Einstein's postulate becomes a derivable consequence.
